'''2023 SDSO Thomas Santosuosso LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Santosuosso]] at [[2023 San Diego Super Open]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Thomas Santosuosso]]
* '''Event:''' [[2023 San Diego Super Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open QMC Santosuosso LS 2023 San.txt |Download]]
